title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Efficiently Improving Generalization
mechanism: Minimise the worst-case loss in a weight neighbourhood of radius rho; seeks flat minima and is robust to label noise.
adaptation: rho {0.02,0.05} on Adam (or ASAM), BN stats from the first pass only; 2x step cost. Crack label jitter is treated as label noise.
evidence: Better generalisation on CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet and fine-tuning tasks; label-noise robustness comparable to dedicated noisy-label methods (abstract).
min_experiment: Arm PF+SAM vs SUP100-PF, seeds 5-9, 20k steps. Metric: test clean crack relF1@2 and IoU, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill if test relF1@2 gain < +0.01 and E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.02; also check 10k / 15k checkpoints (early-stopping effect).
prior_overlap: none. Noisy-label methods and SAM never run.

alt_notes.adaptation: rho in {0.02, 0.05} on the house Adam (or ASAM), 2x step cost; crack label jitter treated as label noise; also score 10k and 15k checkpoints because SAM's label-noise gain is largest with early stopping (arxiv:2405.03676). arxiv:2408.04065 found plain SAM the only sharpness optimizer that consistently helped on medical data.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + SAM, 5 seeds. Baseline: SUP100-PF. Metric: test clean crack relF1@2 and crack IoU, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: test crack relF1@2 gain < +0.01 and E1 crack relF1@2 gain < +0.02.
